description: This file contains a test utility class 'CacheMonitorForTesting' implementing the 'ICacheMonitor' interface for monitoring cache-related metrics, along with a serializable class 'CacheMonitorCounters' that tracks various counters related to cache monitoring.

classes.name: CacheMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of ICacheMonitor that increments counters for various cache events.

classes.name: CacheMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class that holds counters for different cache monitoring events.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Records a cache pressure status change by incrementing its counter.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Records cache size reporting by incrementing its counter.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Records message statistics reporting by incrementing its counter.

methods.name: TrackMessagesAdded
methods.description: Records the addition of messages to the cache.

methods.name: TrackMessagesPurged
methods.description: Records the purging of messages from the cache.
